_readme: Filled from the research notes on 2026-10-22. Each cell is {value, source, checked, note}; cells marked estimate: true or whose source starts with 'estimate' are not published numbers. Rates are USD per GPU-hour. Prices are USD per million tokens. tps_out_per_gpu is the CONSERVATIVE planning output tokens/s per GPU (mixed real traffic at about 50 tok/s per user); tps_out_per_gpu_typical is the TYPICAL planning number (tuned engine, 30 to 50 tok/s per user, 1k/1k-like traffic); ratio_in is input tokens per output token at the benchmark shape (1.0 = 1k/1k). AMD (MI300X, MI355X) and RTX PRO 6000 throughput cells are estimates in the same output-only 1k/1k convention: the NVIDIA planning number scaled by the InferenceX ratio at 50 tok/s per user (InferenceX's own 8k/1k 'tok/s per GPU' counts input plus output and is not used directly). plans: each plan is one GPU type, a node size (1, 6 or 8) and a list of model slugs that must exist in models[] with throughput for that GPU. Revenue per GPU-hour for a plan is the simple mean across its models. Rates come only from providers whose terms were read and permit (or do not forbid) a public paid API; gpus[].rates.test_rate is the single-GPU month-to-month price (Koyeb or Lambda 1x) for the month-to-month test phase, because Vultr's cheaper 8-GPU plans need a manually reviewed account limit; model.py does not read test_rate yet. OpenRouter cells (providers, min/median prices, weekly_tokens, sum_inv_sq_price) are written by model/fill_openrouter.py from the raw endpoints JSON beside the notes. See data/params_notes.md for the reasoning behind every number.

excess_business_loss_cap.source: Rev. Proc. 2025-32 section 4.31: 'For taxable years beginning in 2026 ... the amount under 461(l)(3)(A)(ii)(II) is $256,000 ($512,000 for joint returns)'. https://www.irs.gov/pub/irs-drop/rp-25-32.pdf
excess_business_loss_cap.note: Single filer. Joint filers get $512,000. Disallowed excess becomes an NOL carryforward (IRC 461(l)(2)). California applies its own version (R&TC 17560.5) with a 2025 threshold of $313,000 single / $626,000 joint and a 'carryover excess business loss'; the 2026 California figure is not yet published. The model applies the federal cap to both federal and California. research_notes/GPU rental inference business plan/tax_rules_model_licenses_privacy.md

ca_179_limit.source: R&TC 17255(a): aggregate Section 179 cost 'shall not exceed twenty-five thousand dollars ($25,000)'; FTB 3885A instructions (2025) say the same. https://california.public.law/codes/revenue_and_taxation_code_section_17255 ; https://www.ftb.ca.gov/forms/2025/2025-3885a-instructions.html
ca_179_limit.note: R&TC 17255(b): the $25,000 is reduced dollar for dollar once Section 179 property placed in service in the year exceeds $200,000, so it is $0 for a $225,000+ purchase. The model does not apply the phase-out. research_notes/GPU rental inference business plan/tax_rules_model_licenses_privacy.md

ca_macrs_year1_q4_rate.note: Applies when all MACRS property is placed in service in Q4 2026 (December start). Half-year convention would be 20%. research_notes/GPU rental inference business plan/tax_rules_model_licenses_privacy.md

host_fee.note: Vast does not publish a host fee. Vast blog (May 18, 2026): 'Live GPU prices are typically about 25% above what hosts earn.' Host share = 1/1.25 = 0.80, so fee = 0.20. models.note: 2.8T parameters (OpenRouter card). The OpenRouter notes say 'a 2.8T-parameter checkpoint needs well over 1 TB of GPU memory even at 4-bit'; FP4 weights about 1.4 TB exceed one 8x H200 node (1,128 GB) and leave no KV room on one 8x B200 node (1,440 GB) or 8x MI300X (1,536 GB). An 8x MI355X node (2,304 GB) could hold FP4 weights with about 900 GB headroom, but no throughput measurement exists on any rentable node (InferenceX K3 data: GB300 NVL72 and TPU v7 only), so no GPU key is filled and the model drops out of Plans B, C and E.

plans.note: Same list as Plan D. All MI300X throughput cells are estimates (no AMD benchmark for any of these models); Vultr's terms permit a paid API (gap-closing note) but its 8-GPU plans need a manually reviewed account limit.

plans.label: Plan G: owned 6x RTX PRO 6000 box in colo, mid-size models
plans.note: Owned scenario uses owned.RTXPRO6000 (Bizon X7000 G3 + 6x RTX PRO 6000 Server Edition, Psychz 1-year cabinet). The rented scenarios for this plan use the RTXPRO6000 rental rates (Koyeb) for comparison. Throughput cells are estimates from single-card vLLM and TensorRT-LLM FP4 tables.
